e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: (Name1), a child, watches raindrops race down a smooth stone. Someone begins a quiet song, and another joins in.

e2.text: (Name1), a child, watches raindrops race down a smooth stone. (Name1) had dreaded the weather but now finds it soothing.
